notes.title: FRACT OSC Playable on Steam Deck and it's ON SALE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/5fe7164ebe59519d37b3654b5bc2f00d0eacff52.gif[/img]

Hello Again!

More good news as FRACT OSC has been classified as Playable by the DeckLords at Steam! [b]ALSO, IT'S ON SALE! [/b]In our experience it runs quite great on Deck, and we think you'll enjoy FRACT on the go. While our experience doesn't 100% line up with Valve's assessment, we didn't want to hold up the approval process. 

Three points to note in it's playable status according to Valve:

[list]
[*] [b]This game sometimes shows mouse, keyboard, or non-Steam-Deck controller icons[/b] [i](the default controller bindings are visible in the menu, just navigate with the stick and use RB to 'click')[/i]
[*] [b]Entering some text requires manually invoking the on-screen keyboard[/b] [i](this only effects players who need to name/rename synth presets, likely a TINY fraction of players)[/i]
[*] [b]This game does not exit cleanly and may require you to manually quit via the Steam overlay[/b] [i](we have not seen this behaviour in hours of our own testing, but maybe we're the exception)[/i]
[/list] 
[b]For those of you that have FRACT'd on the go - have you seen the third behaviour with unclean exits?[/b] Before we push Valve to retest this one, we thought we'd ask you folks first!

Thanks,

The phosfiend team
